channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Lebanese in south refuse to flee again despite escalating Israeli strikes
item.description: Obaida Hitto reports from southern Lebanon, where residents say they will not leave again despite intensifying strikes.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump slams Iranian proposal as ceasefire hangs by a thread
item.description: Iran's powerful parliamentary speaker says US has 'no alternative but to accept' Tehran's 14-point proposal to end war.

item.title: UK sanctions network accused of planning attacks for Iran
item.description: Britain freezes assets and travel for those accused of laundering billions and plotting Iranian-backed hostile activity.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire is on ‘life support’ after rejecting Iran’s proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the ceasefire with Iran was “on life support” after rejecting Tehran’s latest proposal.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

item.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
item.description: The EU's foreign policy chief said "extremism and violence carry consequences", while Israel branded the move "arbitrary".

item.title: Whales could be harmed by diverted ships avoiding Middle East, scientists warn
item.description: Ships have rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope since 2023 to avoid conflicts in the Middle East.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

item.title: Ailing Iranian Nobel laureate given bail and hospital transfer
item.description: Iranian authorities granted human rights activist Narges Mohammadi bail amid growing concern over her poor health in prison.

item.title: Iran activists tell BBC how threat of war intensifies trauma of repression
item.description: A dissident in Tehran says she feels helpless and under immense psychological pressure.
